description.value: A free, unlocked wilderness hut at 870 m elevation in the Sea to Sky corridor near Squamish, operated by the 99 Trials Association — a non-profit motorcycle trials club active since 2016. The one-storey wooden cabin offers a basic fireplace shelter for trail users but has no drinking water, toilets, shower, or mattresses. Touring cyclists passing through the area may use it as an emergency or overnight stop on backcountry routes, though facilities are extremely minimal.
